control_failures.control_label: provision and briefing of a competent fire watch
integrity of explosion-protected equipment in zoned areas

facts.hazard_release: fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation
facts.title: hazard report during an intrusive maintenance task on PSV-7104

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was medical treatment injury, with 1 person injured. The potential outcome was rated 3 against the site's consequence scale, above the 2 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control FIRE_WATCH_PROVISION: the provision and briefing of a competent fire watch was not in place, and the root cause analysis classified this as a task or environmental condition.

Control HAZARDOUS_AREA_EQUIPMENT_INTEGRITY: the integrity of explosion-protected equipment in zoned areas was never verified as effective, and the root cause analysis classified this as an individual or team action.
Control SEAL_FACE_TEMPERATURE_ALARM: the seal-face high-temperature alarm and trip was never verified as effective, and the root cause analysis classified this as an absent or failed defence.

recommendations: Restore the seal-face high-temperature alarm and trip on PSV-7104 and record the field verification before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in authorising hot work, specifically assessing and permitting hot work adjacent to live plant. PSV-7104 (tank relief and vent devices) is in service for tank overpressure and vacuum protection. The task proceeded during an intrusive maintenance task while the provision and briefing of a competent fire watch was not in place. The chemical energy involved is held as hydrocarbon, and the recorded presentation was fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation.
response.summary: On 31 August 2014 a hazard report was recorded on PSV-7104 at Cape Verity Export Terminal during an intrusive maintenance task; chemical energy held as hydrocarbon was not released.
